summary: Tested the new Qoyod tenant-identity diagnostics endpoint + UI gating per the user's GO-LIVE concern ("38 products reported but Qoyod UI shows zero"). Backend GET /api/integrations/qoyod/diagnostics/identity returns HTTP 200 with the exact spec shape: mezan.api_key_present=true, api_key_fingerprint='08cef7386398' (sha256[:12] only, raw key never exposed), base_url='https://legacy.qoyod.com/api/2.0', queried_at ISO timestamp; each qoyod sub-section carries the exact endpoint string ('GET /branches', 'GET /products?page=1&limit=5', 'GET /customers?page=1&limit=5'); products and customers both return ok=false with error.code='qoyod_unauthorized', status_code=401, Arabic message — the EXPECTED graceful-partial-failure path on the admin tenant. No 500 crash. Go-live checklist now exposes products_lookup + customers_lookup items with extra.source='qoyod_api_live', endpoint, queried_at (error path; in success path it would also include qoyod_total + sample + qoyod_response_meta). The 22-test pytest suite (test_qoyod_identity_diagnostics.py + test_qoyod_go_live_qyd_fix.py) passes 22/22. Frontend QYD-GO page: the amber-bordered diagnostics card (data-testid='qoyod-identity-diagnostics-card') is positioned between the status banner and the report; the 'تشغيل التشخيص الآن' button (data-testid='btn-run-identity-diag') triggers the call; pre-run placeholder 'لم يتم التشخيص بعد' is visible; after run the fingerprint, base_url, queried_at, and the rose-text error block ('qoyod_unauthorized — مفتاح API غير صالح أو منتهي') are rendered for each endpoint; the confirmation checkbox (data-testid='diag-confirm-identity') only appears AFTER the first diagnostics run and is reset to unchecked on re-run. ACTIVATE button (data-testid='btn-activate-production') stays disabled throughout.
critical_code_review_comments: identity_diagnostics.py correctly hashes the api_key with sha256 and truncates to 12 hex chars — confirmed end-to-end (raw 'live-key-xyz' never appears anywhere in HTTP response body; in live test the only key-derived data was the fingerprint '08cef7386398').
Each section carries the EXACT endpoint string the operator can audit ('GET /products?page=1&limit=5' etc.) — meets the user's #2 demand.

Graceful partial failure validated live: branches returns 404 (qoyod_not_found — '/branches' isn't exposed on Qoyod 2.0), products+customers return 401 (qoyod_unauthorized), endpoint still returns HTTP 200 with structured per-section errors and ok=false overall. Exactly the contract under test.

Frontend: 'diag-products-table' / 'diag-customers-table' testids are conditional — they only render when the corresponding section returned ok=true with rows. Since the live preview returns qoyod_unauthorized, those testids are absent and the rose-text error block is shown instead. This matches the spec literally ('If qoyod returns errors for products/customers, the section shows the error code/message (rose text)').

ACTIVATE-button gating: in this preview the admin tenant is ALREADY in production mode (banner 'وضع الإنتاج مُفعَّل حالياً'), so the button label is correctly 'مُفعَّل ✓' (post-activation state) instead of the pre-activation lock label '🔒 يلزم تأكيد الهوية'. The supporting wiring works (checkbox appears post-run, resets on re-run, button disabled throughout, no warning toast path triggered because tenant is already activated). To exercise the pre-activation gating label visually, the main agent or a future test on a non-activated tenant would need to flip dry_run_mode=true / enabled=false first — recommend a fresh tenant fixture for that path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested testids + behaviors (card visibility, pre/post run placeholder, fingerprint+base_url+endpoint rendering, error rose-text, checkbox conditional render, checkbox reset on re-run, ACTIVATE remains disabled)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The admin@hesab.app tenant in this preview env has a Qoyod API key SAVED but it returns 401 for /products and /customers and 404 for /branches — this is the real upstream state and the diagnostics is designed to surface it transparently (not a bug). To exercise the success path (products/customers tables actually rendering), a tenant with a valid Qoyod key with read scopes would be needed. The pre-activation ACTIVATE-button label '🔒 يلزم تأكيد الهوية' cannot be observed here because tenant is already activated (banner shows 'وضع الإنتاج مُفعَّل حالياً'). Frontend testids verified: qoyod-identity-diagnostics-card, btn-run-identity-diag, diag-confirm-identity, btn-activate-production. Backend route: GET /api/integrations/qoyod/diagnostics/identity. Pytest entry: /app/backend/tests/test_qoyod_identity_diagnostics.py (9 tests).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. The original user-reported discrepancy (38 products vs 0 in UI) is investigated by this diagnostics endpoint, which transparently shows that on this preview tenant the api key fingerprint is 08cef7386398 and Qoyod itself returns 401 for products/customers (key may be revoked / on wrong tenant / lacks scopes). Operator now has the evidence they need to compare the fingerprint with the key in Qoyod's UI and identify the mismatch.
